all_candidates.topic: Is the NEET re-exam process fair to all students?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NEET UG Round 2 seat allotment results were released on September 10, 2026, following a re-exam due to a paper leak.

all_candidates.topic: Are AI-driven tech layoffs in India justified?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Major tech companies are cutting thousands of jobs in Indian tech hubs, replacing human roles with AI, reported September 3, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are FSSAI's red warning labels effective for health?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The FSSAI mandated red warning labels on packaged foods on September 10, 2026, to combat obesity and diabetes rates.

all_candidates.topic: Should companies commit to no AI-driven job cuts?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A study reported on September 7, 2026, shows nearly one in four CHROs expect AI to reduce headcount by 1-20%.

all_candidates.topic: Does E20 petrol truly maintain vehicle efficiency?
all_candidates.news_anchor: PM Advisor Tarun Kapoor stated on September 10, 2026, that E20 works effectively, with higher octane offsetting slight efficiency loss.

all_candidates.topic: Should UPI display fraud warnings for all suspicious payments?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Banks and UPI platforms may display warning pop-ups for suspicious transactions from October 1, 2026, as announced recently.

all_candidates.topic: Will UPI Tap & Pay make transactions too easy for fraud?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The RBI Governor launched UPI 'Tap & Pay' for faster NFC payments on September 10, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should smartphone makers absorb AI-driven cost increases?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's smartphone retail prices surged 21% in 2026 due to AI-driven memory costs, reported September 9, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Does UPI mobile number masking truly enhance privacy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NPCI requires UPI apps to mask mobile numbers and UPI IDs by September 4, 2026, for privacy.

all_candidates.topic: Should new e-commerce rules prevent all "dark patterns"?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government notified the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026 on September 10, 2026, to address dark patterns and enhance consumer protection.

all_candidates.topic: Should companies re-hire for AI-displaced roles by 2029?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Gartner predicted on September 10, 2026, that 30% of jobs cut due to AI could return by 2029.

all_candidates.topic: Should government use viral posts for food safety action?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's food safety crackdown is increasingly fuelled by viral social media posts prompting regulatory inspections, with ongoing actions this week.

all_candidates.topic: Is ₹10,000 UPI biometric limit secure enough?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The per-transaction limit for biometric-authenticated UPI payments was raised to ₹10,000, effective August 7, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should coaching institutes offer more free scholarships?
all_candidates.news_anchor: PWNSAT 2026, a free exam offering 100% scholarships for JEE/NEET coaching, was announced on September 9, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should non-dairy paneer be banned nationwide?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Maharashtra banned analogue (non-dairy) paneer to ensure consumers get genuine milk-based paneer, reported on September 8, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is the E20 rollout successfully boosting green vehicles?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Sales of alternative-fuel passenger vehicles outpaced petrol cars in August 2026, driven by E20 concerns, reported September 7, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is building an Olympic City a wise public investment?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay announced plans for an Olympic City and Motorsports City in Chennai on September 3, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is Delhi's EV mandate fair to fleet operators?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Delhi's EV Policy 2026, announced by September 10, 2026, mandates phasing out petrol/diesel two-wheelers for fleet aggregators by end of 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should AI manage all critical metro rail operations?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's metro systems are increasingly using AI and predictive analytics for improved reliability and safety, reported September 10, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is India's shift back to offline payments concerning?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A study reported on August 25, 2026, highlighted a shift towards offline payments for bills, food, and travel among consumers.
